name: CI

permissions:
  contents: read

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
      - 'feature/**'
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  lint-and-test:
    name: Lint & Regression Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: Install ShellCheck
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y shellcheck

      - name: Run ShellCheck
        run: |
          shellcheck build.sh tests/*.sh scripts/release/*.sh
          shellcheck -e SC2155,SC2010,SC2086,SC1091 scripts/code-interpreter.sh scripts/code-interpreter-env.sh

      - name: Check Shell Syntax
        run: |
          for f in build.sh scripts/*.sh tests/*.sh scripts/release/*.sh; do
            echo "Checking syntax: $f"
            bash -n "$f"
          done

      - name: Check Python Syntax
        run: |
          python3 -m py_compile scripts/jupyter_notebook_config.py tests/smoke_test_kernels.py

      - name: Run Node Setup Regression Test
        run: |
          bash tests/test_code_interpreter_node_setup.sh

  build-and-smoke-test:
    name: Build & Smoke Test (${{ matrix.arch }})
    needs: lint-and-test
    timeout-minutes: 45
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            arch: amd64
          - os: ubuntu-24.04-arm
            arch: arm64
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: Free disk space
        run: |
          sudo rm -rf /usr/share/dotnet /opt/ghc /opt/hostedtoolcache
          sudo apt-get clean
          sudo rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
          df -h

      - name: Build Base and Main Images Locally
        run: |
          TAG=ci-test ./build.sh

      - name: Run Reusable Kernel Smoke Test
        run: |
          ./tests/smoke_test.sh opensandbox/code-interpreter:ci-test

set -euo pipefail

repo_root=$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)
script="$repo_root/scripts/code-interpreter.sh"
sandbox=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$sandbox"' EXIT

write_tslab_stub() {
	cat >"$sandbox/tslab" <<'STUB'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
echo "tslab $*" >>"$CALL_LOG"
STUB
	chmod +x "$sandbox/tslab"
}

cat >"$sandbox/npm" <<'STUB'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
echo "npm $*" >>"$CALL_LOG"
if [ "$1 $2 $3" = "install -g tslab" ]; then
	cat >"$TEST_BIN_DIR/tslab" <<'TSLAB'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
echo "tslab $*" >>"$CALL_LOG"
TSLAB
	chmod +x "$TEST_BIN_DIR/tslab"
fi
STUB
write_tslab_stub
cat >"$sandbox/jupyter" <<'STUB'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
if [ "$1" = "kernelspec" ] && [ "$2" = "list" ]; then
	cat "$JUPYTER_KERNELS"
fi
STUB
chmod +x "$sandbox/npm" "$sandbox/jupyter"

extract_node_setup() {
	awk '
		/^tslab_kernels_installed\(\)/ {emit=1}
		emit {print}
		/^setup_node\(\)/ {in_setup=1}
		in_setup && /^}/ {exit}
	' "$script"
}

run_setup_node() {
	CALL_LOG=$1 JUPYTER_KERNELS=$2 TEST_BIN_DIR="$sandbox" PATH="$sandbox:$PATH" bash -c "$(extract_node_setup); setup_node"
}

call_log="$sandbox/calls-installed.log"
kernels="$sandbox/kernels-installed.txt"
cat >"$kernels" <<'KERNELS'
Available kernels:
  python    /usr/local/share/jupyter/kernels/python
  tslab     /usr/local/share/jupyter/kernels/tslab
  jslab     /usr/local/share/jupyter/kernels/jslab
KERNELS
run_setup_node "$call_log" "$kernels"
if [ -s "$call_log" ]; then
	echo "expected no npm or tslab calls when kernels are already installed" >&2
	cat "$call_log" >&2
	exit 1
fi

call_log="$sandbox/calls-missing-kernels.log"
kernels="$sandbox/kernels-missing.txt"
cat >"$kernels" <<'KERNELS'
Available kernels:
  python    /usr/local/share/jupyter/kernels/python
KERNELS
run_setup_node "$call_log" "$kernels"
if grep -q '^npm install -g tslab$' "$call_log"; then
	echo "did not expect npm install when tslab command exists" >&2
	cat "$call_log" >&2
	exit 1
fi
if ! grep -q '^tslab install$' "$call_log"; then
	echo "expected tslab install when kernels are missing" >&2
	cat "$call_log" >&2
	exit 1
fi

call_log="$sandbox/calls-partial-kernels.log"
kernels="$sandbox/kernels-partial.txt"
cat >"$kernels" <<'KERNELS'
Available kernels:
  python    /usr/local/share/jupyter/kernels/python
  tslab     /usr/local/share/jupyter/kernels/tslab
KERNELS
run_setup_node "$call_log" "$kernels"
if grep -q '^npm install -g tslab$' "$call_log"; then
	echo "did not expect npm install when tslab command exists" >&2
	cat "$call_log" >&2
	exit 1
fi
if ! grep -q '^tslab install$' "$call_log"; then
	echo "expected tslab install when one kernel is missing" >&2
	cat "$call_log" >&2
	exit 1
fi

rm "$sandbox/tslab"
call_log="$sandbox/calls-missing-command.log"
run_setup_node "$call_log" "$kernels"
if ! grep -q '^npm install -g tslab$' "$call_log"; then
	echo "expected npm install when tslab command is missing" >&2
	cat "$call_log" >&2
	exit 1
fi

name: Release Preflight

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      require_approval:
        description: Require approval through the release environment
        required: false
        default: true
        type: boolean
    outputs:
      release_tag:
        description: Validated semantic version release tag
        value: ${{ jobs.verify-source.outputs.release_tag }}

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  verify-source:
    name: Verify release tag and source
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      release_tag: ${{ steps.validate_tag.outputs.release_tag }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Validate release tag
        id: validate_tag
        env:
          REF_TYPE: ${{ github.ref_type }}
          REF_NAME: ${{ github.ref_name }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [[ "${REF_TYPE}" != "tag" ]]; then
            echo "::error::Release workflow can only run on git tags, got REF_TYPE=${REF_TYPE} (ref=${REF_NAME})."
            echo "For manual triggers, choose an existing tag matching 'vX.Y.Z'."
            exit 1
          fi

          if [[ ! "${REF_NAME}" =~ ^v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+(-[0-9A-Za-z.-]+)?$ ]]; then
            echo "::error::Tag '${REF_NAME}' does not match required semver release format 'vX.Y.Z' (e.g. v1.0.0, v1.0.0-rc.1)."
            exit 1
          fi

          echo "release_tag=${REF_NAME}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "Validated release tag: ${REF_NAME}"

      - name: Verify release commit is reachable from main
        run: scripts/release/verify-release-ref.sh

  approve-release:
    name: Approve release
    if: ${{ inputs.require_approval }}
    needs: verify-source
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: release
    steps:
      - name: Record approval
        run: echo "Release environment approval granted."

name: Release

permissions:
  contents: read
  id-token: write
  attestations: write
  artifact-metadata: write
  packages: write

concurrency:
  group: release
  cancel-in-progress: false

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v*'

jobs:
  preflight:
    name: Release preflight
    uses: ./.github/workflows/release-preflight.yml
    with:
      require_approval: true

  publish:
    name: Build & Publish Release Images
    needs: preflight
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: Set up QEMU
        uses: docker/setup-qemu-action@v3

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Install Cosign
        uses: sigstore/cosign-installer@v4.1.1

      - name: Login to DockerHub
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          username: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_USERNAME }}
          password: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_PASSWORD }}

      - name: Login to ACR
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          registry: sandbox-registry.cn-zhangjiakou.cr.aliyuncs.com
          username: ${{ secrets.ACR_USERNAME }}
          password: ${{ secrets.ACR_PASSWORD }}

      - name: Login to GHCR
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          registry: ghcr.io
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Free disk space
        run: |
          sudo rm -rf /usr/share/dotnet /opt/ghc /opt/hostedtoolcache
          sudo apt-get clean
          sudo rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
          df -h

      - name: Build and push release images
        id: build
        env:
          TAG: ${{ needs.preflight.outputs.release_tag }}
          PUSH: "true"
          GHCR_REPO: ghcr.io/opensandbox-group/opensandbox
          BUILD_METADATA_FILE: ${{ runner.temp }}/code-interpreter-metadata.json
          BASE_BUILD_METADATA_FILE: ${{ runner.temp }}/code-interpreter-base-metadata.json
        run: |
          ./build.sh

          BASE_DIGEST="$(jq -r '."containerimage.digest" // empty' "$BASE_BUILD_METADATA_FILE")"
          if [[ -z "$BASE_DIGEST" ]]; then
            echo "Unable to resolve base image digest from $BASE_BUILD_METADATA_FILE" >&2
            cat "$BASE_BUILD_METADATA_FILE" >&2 || true
            exit 1
          fi

          MAIN_DIGEST="$(jq -r '."containerimage.digest" // empty' "$BUILD_METADATA_FILE")"
          if [[ -z "$MAIN_DIGEST" ]]; then
            echo "Unable to resolve main image digest from $BUILD_METADATA_FILE" >&2
            cat "$BUILD_METADATA_FILE" >&2 || true
            exit 1
          fi

          echo "base_digest=${BASE_DIGEST}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "main_digest=${MAIN_DIGEST}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "base_dockerhub=docker.io/opensandbox/code-interpreter-base" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "base_acr=sandbox-registry.cn-zhangjiakou.cr.aliyuncs.com/opensandbox/code-interpreter-base" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "base_ghcr=${GHCR_REPO}/code-interpreter-base" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "main_dockerhub=docker.io/opensandbox/code-interpreter" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "main_acr=sandbox-registry.cn-zhangjiakou.cr.aliyuncs.com/opensandbox/code-interpreter" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "main_ghcr=${GHCR_REPO}/code-interpreter" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Sign release images with Cosign
        env:
          BASE_DIGEST: ${{ steps.build.outputs.base_digest }}
          BASE_DOCKERHUB: ${{ steps.build.outputs.base_dockerhub }}
          BASE_ACR: ${{ steps.build.outputs.base_acr }}
          BASE_GHCR: ${{ steps.build.outputs.base_ghcr }}
          MAIN_DIGEST: ${{ steps.build.outputs.main_digest }}
          MAIN_DOCKERHUB: ${{ steps.build.outputs.main_dockerhub }}
          MAIN_ACR: ${{ steps.build.outputs.main_acr }}
          MAIN_GHCR: ${{ steps.build.outputs.main_ghcr }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          echo "Signing base images..."
          cosign sign --yes \
            "${BASE_DOCKERHUB}@${BASE_DIGEST}" \
            "${BASE_ACR}@${BASE_DIGEST}" \
            "${BASE_GHCR}@${BASE_DIGEST}"

          echo "Signing main images..."
          cosign sign --yes \
            "${MAIN_DOCKERHUB}@${MAIN_DIGEST}" \
            "${MAIN_ACR}@${MAIN_DIGEST}" \
            "${MAIN_GHCR}@${MAIN_DIGEST}"

      - name: Attest base image (DockerHub)
        uses: actions/attest@v4
        with:
          subject-name: ${{ steps.build.outputs.base_dockerhub }}
          subject-digest: ${{ steps.build.outputs.base_digest }}
          push-to-registry: true
          create-storage-record: false

      - name: Attest base image (ACR)
        uses: actions/attest@v4
        with:
          subject-name: ${{ steps.build.outputs.base_acr }}
          subject-digest: ${{ steps.build.outputs.base_digest }}
          push-to-registry: true
          create-storage-record: false

      - name: Attest base image (GHCR)
        uses: actions/attest@v4
        with:
          subject-name: ${{ steps.build.outputs.base_ghcr }}
          subject-digest: ${{ steps.build.outputs.base_digest }}
          push-to-registry: true
          create-storage-record: false

      - name: Attest main image (DockerHub)
        uses: actions/attest@v4
        with:
          subject-name: ${{ steps.build.outputs.main_dockerhub }}
          subject-digest: ${{ steps.build.outputs.main_digest }}
          push-to-registry: true
          create-storage-record: false

      - name: Attest main image (ACR)
        uses: actions/attest@v4
        with:
          subject-name: ${{ steps.build.outputs.main_acr }}
          subject-digest: ${{ steps.build.outputs.main_digest }}
          push-to-registry: true
          create-storage-record: false

      - name: Attest main image (GHCR)
        uses: actions/attest@v4
        with:
          subject-name: ${{ steps.build.outputs.main_ghcr }}
          subject-digest: ${{ steps.build.outputs.main_digest }}
          push-to-registry: true
          create-storage-record: false

# OpenSandbox 沙箱环境镜像

中文 | [English](README.md)

本仓库包含 OpenSandbox 沙箱环境镜像的独立 Docker 构建文件、运行时脚本、测试套件以及 CI 与发布工作流。目前支持 Code Interpreter（`code-interpreter`）环境。该镜像基于 `Ubuntu 24.04`，预装了多种主流编程语言及其多版本环境，旨在提供一个开箱即用的多语言代码执行沙箱。

## 来源背景与上游追溯

- **上游来源**：从核心 [OpenSandbox](https://github.com/opensandbox-group/OpenSandbox) 单体仓库的 `sandboxes/code-interpreter` 目录独立拆分而来，对应提交为 [`4e69fc5fe478651b2e297d38a06d6ddeb805795e`](https://github.com/opensandbox-group/OpenSandbox/commit/4e69fc5fe478651b2e297d38a06d6ddeb805795e)（相关工作见 [Issue #1764](https://github.com/opensandbox-group/OpenSandbox/issues/1764)）。
- **历史保留**：完整保留了该模块的 Git 提交历史（根目录路径映射虽使提交 SHA 发生变化，但提交作者、提交信息及时间线完整保留）。
- **生态关联**：本仓库目前提供 `code-interpreter` 与 `code-interpreter-base` 镜像的独立构建、测试与发版，并与以下项目协同工作：
  - [OpenSandbox 主仓库](https://github.com/opensandbox-group/OpenSandbox)
  - [OpenSandbox API 规范](https://github.com/opensandbox-group/OpenSandbox/tree/main/specs)
  - [OpenSandbox SDKs](https://github.com/opensandbox-group/OpenSandbox/tree/main/sdks)
  - [OpenSandbox 官方文档](https://open-sandbox.ai)

## 特性

- **多语言支持**：预装 Python、Java、Node.js 和 Go 及其多个版本
- **版本切换**：无需重新构建，通过 `/opt/code-interpreter/code-interpreter-env.sh` 支持运行时快速切换环境版本
- **Jupyter 集成**：内置 Jupyter Notebook 服务并预配置各语言内核
- **多架构支持**：原生支持 `linux/amd64` 与 `linux/arm64` 架构
- **clone3-workaround（仅限 amd64）**：在 **linux/amd64** 镜像中预装 [AkihiroSuda/clone3-workaround](https://github.com/AkihiroSuda/clone3-workaround) v1.0.0 至 `/usr/local/bin/clone3-workaround`，并预装 `libseccomp2`，以便在极旧 Docker/containerd 宿主机上正常运行。
- **独立构建与发布**：支持无凭证的本地基础镜像与主镜像联调测试，支持多架构自动构建签名与发版。

## 支持的语言与版本

镜像内预置了以下语言和版本：

| 语言          | 支持版本                          | 安装路径                   | 备注                     |
|:------------|:------------------------------|:-----------------------|:-----------------------|
| **Python**  | 3.10, 3.11, 3.12, 3.13, 3.14* | `/opt/python/versions` | 使用 `uv` 安装；3.14 为实验性版本 |
| **Java**    | 8, 11, 17, 21                 | `/usr/lib/jvm`         | OpenJDK; 含 Maven 3.9.2 |
| **Node.js** | v18, v20, v22                 | `/opt/node`            | 官方 Linux 二进制包          |
| **Go**      | 1.23, 1.24, 1.25              | `/opt/go`              | 官方 Linux 二进制包          |

*> 注意: 版本号可能会随构建时间更新至小版本的最新版。*

## 快速开始

### 1. 本地构建镜像

使用 `build.sh` 脚本可顺序构建 `code-interpreter-base` 与 `code-interpreter`，并将镜像载入本地 Docker 守护进程：

```bash
# 依次构建基础镜像与主镜像（使用刚刚构建好的本地基础镜像）
./build.sh

# 或指定自定义标签
TAG=my-dev-build ./build.sh
```

也可以直接使用标准 `docker build` 构建主镜像，Dockerfile 支持 `BASE_IMAGE` 参数（默认值保持向下兼容）：

```bash
# 使用默认基础镜像构建
docker build -t opensandbox/code-interpreter:latest .

# 使用指定基础镜像构建
docker build --build-arg BASE_IMAGE=opensandbox/code-interpreter-base:my-dev-build \
  -t opensandbox/code-interpreter:my-dev-build .
```

### 2. 运行容器

**默认启动：**

```bash
docker run -d --name code-interpreter opensandbox/code-interpreter:latest
```

> **关于端口暴露的说明**：Jupyter Notebook 默认仅监听容器回环地址（`127.0.0.1:44771`），专供 OpenSandbox 和 `execd` 内部调用。宿主机 `-p` 端口映射无法直接访问该内部回环服务。请通过 OpenSandbox SDK 或 execd 运行时访问内核；如需进行容器本地诊断，请使用 `docker exec`：
> ```bash
> docker exec code-interpreter curl -sf "http://127.0.0.1:44771/api/status?token=[REDACTED]"
> ```

**指定运行时语言版本：**

```bash
docker run -it --rm \
  -e PYTHON_VERSION=3.11 \
  -e JAVA_VERSION=17 \
  -e NODE_VERSION=20 \
  -e GO_VERSION=1.24 \
  opensandbox/code-interpreter:latest
```

### `EXECD_CLONE3_COMPAT`（clone3-workaround）

若将 `EXECD_CLONE3_COMPAT` 设为 `1`、`true`、`yes`、`on` 或 `reexec`（与 [OpenSandbox execd](https://github.com/opensandbox-group/OpenSandbox/blob/main/components/execd/README.md#沙箱内的-linux-clone3-兼容) 行为一致），入口脚本会在启动 Jupyter/内核前使用 **`/usr/local/bin/clone3-workaround` 重新 `exec` 自身**。**linux/amd64** 镜像内置该二进制；**arm64** 构建会打印警告并跳过包装。包装成功后脚本会在当前进程树中 **`unset` `EXECD_CLONE3_COMPAT`**。设为 `0`、`false`、`off`、`no` 或不设置则关闭此功能。

## 如何切换版本

镜像内置了环境切换脚本 `/opt/code-interpreter/code-interpreter-env.sh`，使用 `source` 命令加载它以修改当前 Shell 的环境变量：

### 基本用法

```bash
source /opt/code-interpreter/code-interpreter-env.sh <language> <version>
```

### 示例

**切换 Python 版本：**

```bash
source /opt/code-interpreter/code-interpreter-env.sh python 3.11
python3 --version
```

**切换 Java 版本：**

```bash
source /opt/code-interpreter/code-interpreter-env.sh java 8
java -version
```

**切换 Node.js 版本：**

```bash
source /opt/code-interpreter/code-interpreter-env.sh node 22
node -v
```

**切换 Go 版本：**

```bash
source /opt/code-interpreter/code-interpreter-env.sh go 1.25
go version
```

### 查看可用版本

如果不指定版本号，脚本会列出当前镜像内已安装的所有可用版本：

```bash
source /opt/code-interpreter/code-interpreter-env.sh python
source /opt/code-interpreter/code-interpreter-env.sh java
source /opt/code-interpreter/code-interpreter-env.sh node
source /opt/code-interpreter/code-interpreter-env.sh go
```

## 默认版本

容器启动时的默认版本配置如下：

- **Python**: 3.14
- **Java**: 21
- **Node.js**: 22
- **Go**: 1.25

## Jupyter Notebook 集成

### 可用内核

镜像预配置了所有支持语言的 Jupyter 内核：

- **Python**：已安装 Python 版本的 ipykernel
- **Java**：IJava 内核
- **TypeScript/JavaScript**：tslab 内核（包含 `tslab` 和 `jslab`）
- **Go**：gonb 内核
- **Bash**：bash_kernel

### 启动 Jupyter

入口脚本会自动启动 Jupyter Notebook 服务：

```bash
/opt/code-interpreter/code-interpreter.sh
```

### 环境变量

- `JUPYTER_HOST`：Jupyter 服务监听地址（默认：`http://127.0.0.1:44771`）
- `JUPYTER_PORT`：Jupyter 服务端口（默认：`44771`）
- `JUPYTER_TOKEN`：访问令牌（默认：`opensandboxcodeinterpreterjupyter`）

## 独立构建流程与配置

`./build.sh` 脚本通过标准环境变量驱动基础镜像与主镜像的顺序构建。

### 构建模式

1. **本地单架构构建**（默认）：
   ```bash
   ./build.sh
   # 或指定自定义标签：
   TAG=my-tag ./build.sh
   ```

# OpenSandbox Sandbox Environment Images

English | [中文](README_zh.md)

This repository contains the standalone Docker build files, runtime scripts, test suites, and CI/release workflows for OpenSandbox sandbox environment images. Currently, the Code Interpreter (`code-interpreter`) environment is supported. The image is based on `Ubuntu 24.04` and comes pre-installed with multiple mainstream programming languages and multi-version environments, designed to provide an out-of-the-box multi-language code execution sandbox.

## Provenance & Upstream Origin

- **Upstream Origin**: Extracted from the `sandboxes/code-interpreter` directory of the core [OpenSandbox](https://github.com/opensandbox-group/OpenSandbox) monorepo at commit [`4e69fc5fe478651b2e297d38a06d6ddeb805795e`](https://github.com/opensandbox-group/OpenSandbox/commit/4e69fc5fe478651b2e297d38a06d6ddeb805795e) (tracked in [issue #1764](https://github.com/opensandbox-group/OpenSandbox/issues/1764)).
- **History Preservation**: Full commit history has been preserved (commit SHAs were rewritten during root extraction, but original author metadata, commit messages, and change chronology are preserved).
- **Ecosystem Links**: Currently, this repository builds, tests, and publishes the `code-interpreter` and `code-interpreter-base` images. It works alongside:
  - [OpenSandbox Core Repository](https://github.com/opensandbox-group/OpenSandbox)
  - [OpenSandbox API Specifications](https://github.com/opensandbox-group/OpenSandbox/tree/main/specs)
  - [OpenSandbox SDKs](https://github.com/opensandbox-group/OpenSandbox/tree/main/sdks)
  - [OpenSandbox Documentation](https://open-sandbox.ai)

## Features

- **Multi-Language Support**: Pre-installed Python, Java, Node.js, and Go with multiple versions
- **Version Switching**: Easy runtime version switching without rebuilding via `/opt/code-interpreter/code-interpreter-env.sh`
- **Jupyter Integration**: Built-in Jupyter Notebook server with pre-configured multi-language kernels
- **Multi-Architecture**: Native support for both `linux/amd64` and `linux/arm64`

- **Independent Build & Release**: Can independently build base and main images, test locally without credentials, and publish signed multiarch images.

## Quick Start

### 1. Build the Images Locally

Use `build.sh` to build both `code-interpreter-base` and `code-interpreter` locally and load them into your Docker daemon:

```bash
# Build base image, then main image using that newly built base (loaded into local Docker)
./build.sh

# Or specify a custom tag
TAG=my-dev-build ./build.sh
```

You can also build the main `Dockerfile` directly with standard `docker build`. The `BASE_IMAGE` build argument defaults to `opensandbox/code-interpreter-base:latest`:

```bash
# Build using default base image
docker build -t opensandbox/code-interpreter:latest .

# Build with a custom or local base image
docker build --build-arg BASE_IMAGE=opensandbox/code-interpreter-base:my-dev-build \
  -t opensandbox/code-interpreter:my-dev-build .
```

### 2. Run the Container

**Default startup:**

```bash
docker run -d --name code-interpreter opensandbox/code-interpreter:latest
```

> **Note on Port Exposure**: By default, Jupyter Notebook listens on container loopback (`127.0.0.1:44771`) as an internal service for OpenSandbox and `execd`. Host `-p` port mapping does not expose loopback services to the host. Access kernels through OpenSandbox/execd, or perform container-local diagnostics via `docker exec`:
> ```bash
> docker exec code-interpreter curl -sf "http://127.0.0.1:44771/api/status?token=[REDACTED]"
> ```

**With Custom Language Version Selection:**

```bash
docker run -it --rm \
  -e PYTHON_VERSION=3.11 \
  -e JAVA_VERSION=17 \
  -e NODE_VERSION=20 \
  -e GO_VERSION=1.24 \
  opensandbox/code-interpreter:latest
```

### `EXECD_CLONE3_COMPAT` (clone3-workaround)

If you set `EXECD_CLONE3_COMPAT` to `1`, `true`, `yes`, `on`, or `reexec` (compatible with [OpenSandbox execd](https://github.com/opensandbox-group/OpenSandbox/blob/main/components/execd/README.md#linux-clone3-compatibility-inside-sandboxes)), the entrypoint script **re-executes itself** under `/usr/local/bin/clone3-workaround` before Jupyter and kernel setup. That binary is included on **linux/amd64** only; on **arm64** builds the script prints a warning and continues without wrapping. After a successful wrap, the script **unsets** `EXECD_CLONE3_COMPAT` in the running process tree. Use `0`, `false`, `off`, `no`, or leave unset to disable.

## Release Process & Security

### Release Triggering & Semver Policy

- **Explicit Tags**: Releases are published by pushing a tag matching `vX.Y.Z` (e.g. `v1.0.0`, with optional prerelease suffix `v1.0.0-rc.1`) or manually triggering `workflow_dispatch` on an existing version tag.
- **No Automatic `:latest`**: Release workflows publish only the explicit semantic version tag. No mutable public `:latest` tags are overwritten as part of the migration.
- **Tag Validation & Preflight**: Preflight validates that the git ref is a semantic version tag and verifies commit reachability from `origin/main` (`scripts/release/verify-release-ref.sh`) before release approval or build.
- **Concurrency**: Concurrency is locked to `group: release, cancel-in-progress: false` to prevent overlapping deployments.

### Required Repository Secrets & Environment

1. **Repository Secrets**:
   - `DOCKERHUB_USERNAME`, `DOCKERHUB_PASSWORD`: Docker Hub credentials
   - `ACR_USERNAME`, `ACR_PASSWORD`: Alibaba Cloud Container Registry credentials
2. **GHCR Permissions**:
   - Uses `GITHUB_TOKEN` with `packages: write` permission. Existing GHCR packages must also grant this repository Actions write access.
3. **Protected Environment**:
   - A GitHub Environment named `release` must be configured with required reviewers to approve releases.

### Sigstore Keyless Signing & Provenance

Release images are signed with Sigstore Cosign using GitHub Actions OIDC identity:

- **Signer Workflow Identity**:
  - Issuer: `https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com`
  - Workflow Ref: `https://github.com/opensandbox-group/sandbox-images/.github/workflows/release.yml@refs/tags/<version>`

- **Cosign Verification**:
  ```bash
  cosign verify \
    --certificate-identity-regexp '^https://github\.com/opensandbox-group/sandbox-images/\.github/workflows/release\.yml@refs/tags/v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' \
    --certificate-oidc-issuer 'https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com' \
    docker.io/opensandbox/code-interpreter:v1.0.0
  ```

- **GitHub Attestation Verification**:
  ```bash
  gh attestation verify oci://docker.io/opensandbox/code-interpreter:v1.0.0 \
    --repo opensandbox-group/sandbox-images
  ```

> **Historical Note**: Images published prior to repository extraction (e.g., `v1.1.0` or earlier) were signed under the upstream monorepo workflow identity (`opensandbox-group/OpenSandbox/.github/workflows/publish-components.yml`). Releases from this repository onward carry the `opensandbox-group/sandbox-images` identity.

"""Focused image smoke test for OpenSandbox code-interpreter.

Verifies:
1. HTTP health endpoint and status
2. Installed Jupyter kernelspecs (python, java, tslab, jslab, gonb, bash)
3. Real execution via WebSocket for each kernel:
   - Python: execution and state reuse on the same kernel
   - Java (IJava): execution
   - JavaScript (jslab): execution
   - TypeScript (tslab): execution
   - Go (gonb): execution
   - Bash: execution
"""

import json
import time
import urllib.request
import uuid
import websocket

BASE_URL = "http://127.0.0.1:44771"
WS_URL = "ws://127.0.0.1:44771"
TOKEN = "[REDACTED]"


def wait_for_health(timeout=30):
    print("==> Checking Jupyter HTTP status...")
    url = f"{BASE_URL}/api/status?token={TOKEN}"
    deadline = time.time() + timeout
    while time.time() < deadline:
        try:
            req = urllib.request.Request(url)
            with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=3) as resp:
                if resp.status == 200:
                    data = json.loads(resp.read().decode())
                    print(f"Jupyter health OK: {data}")
                    return
        except Exception:
            time.sleep(1)
    raise TimeoutError("Jupyter server did not respond with 200 within timeout")


def verify_kernelspecs(timeout=30):
    print("==> Verifying required kernelspecs...")
    url = f"{BASE_URL}/api/kernelspecs?token={TOKEN}"
    required = ["java", "tslab", "jslab", "gonb", "bash"]
    deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout
    installed = []
    while time.monotonic() < deadline:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=5) as resp:
            specs = json.loads(resp.read()).get("kernelspecs", {})
        installed = list(specs)
        if all(name in specs for name in required) and (
            "python" in specs or "python3" in specs
        ):
            print(f"Installed kernelspecs: {installed}")
            return specs
        time.sleep(1)
    raise TimeoutError(f"Required kernels did not become ready; installed: {installed}")


class KernelSession:
    def __init__(self, kernel_name):
        self.kernel_name = kernel_name
        self.kernel_id = None
        self.ws = None

    def __enter__(self):
        url = f"{BASE_URL}/api/kernels?token={TOKEN}"
        payload = json.dumps({"name": self.kernel_name}).encode()
        req = urllib.request.Request(
            url, data=payload, headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"}
        )
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=15) as resp:
            data = json.loads(resp.read().decode())
            self.kernel_id = data["id"]

        ws_url = f"{WS_URL}/api/kernels/{self.kernel_id}/channels?token={TOKEN}"
        self.ws = websocket.create_connection(ws_url, timeout=30)
        print(f"Connected to {self.kernel_name} kernel ({self.kernel_id})")
        return self

    def execute(self, code, timeout=30):
        msg_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
        session_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
        msg = {
            "header": {
                "msg_id": msg_id,
                "username": "smoke_tester",
                "session": session_id,
                "msg_type": "execute_request",
                "version": "5.3",
            },
            "parent_header": {},
            "metadata": {},
            "content": {
                "code": code,
                "silent": False,
                "store_history": True,
                "user_expressions": {},
                "allow_stdin": False,
            },
            "channel": "shell",
        }
        self.ws.send(json.dumps(msg))

        outputs = []
        errors = []
        completed = False
        reply_status = None
        deadline = time.time() + timeout

        while time.time() < deadline:
            self.ws.settimeout(max(1.0, deadline - time.time()))
            try:
                raw = self.ws.recv()
            except websocket.WebSocketTimeoutException:
                continue
            data = json.loads(raw)
            parent_id = data.get("parent_header", {}).get("msg_id")
            if parent_id != msg_id:
                continue

            msg_type = data.get("msg_type")
            content = data.get("content", {})

            if msg_type == "stream":
                outputs.append(content.get("text", ""))
            elif msg_type == "execute_result":
                text = content.get("data", {}).get("text/plain", "")
                if text:
                    outputs.append(str(text))
            elif msg_type == "error":
                ename = content.get("ename", "")
                evalue = content.get("evalue", "")
                traceback = "\n".join(content.get("traceback", []))
                errors.append(f"{ename}: {evalue}\n{traceback}")
            elif msg_type == "status":
                if content.get("execution_state") == "idle":
                    completed = True
            elif msg_type == "execute_reply":
                reply_status = content.get("status")
            if completed and reply_status is not None:
                break

        full_output = "".join(outputs).strip()
        if not completed or reply_status is None:
            raise TimeoutError(f"[{self.kernel_name}] Execution did not complete: {full_output}")
        if reply_status != "ok":
            errors.append(f"execute_reply status: {reply_status}")
        if errors:
            full_error = "\n".join(errors)
            raise RuntimeError(
                f"[{self.kernel_name}] Execution error: {full_error}\nOutput: {full_output}"
            )
        return full_output

    def __exit__(self, exc_type, exc_val, exc_tb):
        if self.ws:
            try:
                self.ws.close()
            except Exception:
                pass
        if self.kernel_id:
            try:
                url = f"{BASE_URL}/api/kernels/{self.kernel_id}?token={TOKEN}"
                req = urllib.request.Request(url, method="DELETE")
                with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=5) as resp:
                    pass
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"Warning closing kernel {self.kernel_id}: {e}")


def main():
    wait_for_health(timeout=30)
    specs = verify_kernelspecs()

    # 1. Python: test execution and same-kernel state reuse
    py_kernel = "python" if "python" in specs else "python3"
    print(f"==> Testing {py_kernel} kernel and state reuse...")
    with KernelSession(py_kernel) as session:
        out1 = session.execute('x = 40 + 2\nprint(f"PY_INIT_{x}")')
        print(f"Python step 1 output: {out1}")
        if "PY_INIT_42" not in out1:
            raise AssertionError(f"Expected PY_INIT_42 in output, got: {out1}")

        out2 = session.execute('print(f"PY_STATE_{x + 10}")')
        print(f"Python step 2 output: {out2}")
        if "PY_STATE_52" not in out2:
            raise AssertionError(
                f"Expected PY_STATE_52 in reused state output, got: {out2}"
            )
    print("Python kernel execution & state reuse: PASS")

    # 2. Java
    print("==> Testing Java kernel...")
    with KernelSession("java") as session:
        out = session.execute('System.out.println("JAVA_OUTPUT_" + (100 + 23));')
        print(f"Java output: {out}")
        if "JAVA_OUTPUT_123" not in out:
            raise AssertionError(f"Expected JAVA_OUTPUT_123, got: {out}")
    print("Java kernel: PASS")

    # 3. JavaScript (jslab)
    print("==> Testing jslab kernel...")
    with KernelSession("jslab") as session:
        out = session.execute('console.log("JSLAB_OUTPUT_" + (50 + 5));')
        print(f"jslab output: {out}")
        if "JSLAB_OUTPUT_55" not in out:
            raise AssertionError(f"Expected JSLAB_OUTPUT_55, got: {out}")
    print("jslab kernel: PASS")

    # 4. TypeScript (tslab)
    print("==> Testing tslab kernel...")
    with KernelSession("tslab") as session:
        out = session.execute(
            'const val: number = 70 + 7; console.log("TSLAB_OUTPUT_" + val);'
        )
        print(f"tslab output: {out}")
        if "TSLAB_OUTPUT_77" not in out:
            raise AssertionError(f"Expected TSLAB_OUTPUT_77, got: {out}")
    print("tslab kernel: PASS")

    # 5. Go (gonb)
    print("==> Testing gonb kernel...")
    with KernelSession("gonb") as session:
        go_code = 'import "fmt"\n\nfunc main() {\n\tfmt.Println("GONB_OUTPUT_99")\n}'
        out = session.execute(go_code)
        print(f"gonb output: {out}")
        if "GONB_OUTPUT_99" not in out:
            raise AssertionError(f"Expected GONB_OUTPUT_99, got: {out}")
    print("gonb kernel: PASS")

    # 6. Bash
    print("==> Testing bash kernel...")
    with KernelSession("bash") as session:
        out = session.execute('echo "BASH_OUTPUT_$((10 + 5))"')
        print(f"bash output: {out}")
        if "BASH_OUTPUT_15" not in out:
            raise AssertionError(f"Expected BASH_OUTPUT_15, got: {out}")
    print("bash kernel: PASS")

    print("\n==========================================")
    print("ALL KERNELS PASSED VERIFICATION!")
    print("==========================================")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# If EXECD_CLONE3_COMPAT is set (same accepted values as execd's pkg/clone3compat), re-exec this
# script under AkihiroSuda/clone3-workaround so the rest of startup runs with clone3 -> ENOSYS.
# See https://github.com/AkihiroSuda/clone3-workaround — binary is /usr/local/bin/clone3-workaround (amd64 image only).
_execd_clone3_compat_normalized=$(
	echo "${EXECD_CLONE3_COMPAT:-}" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]' | sed 's/^[[:space:]]*//;s/[[:space:]]*$//'
)
case "${_execd_clone3_compat_normalized}" in
"" | 0 | false | off | no) ;;
1 | true | yes | on | reexec)
	if [ -z "${_CODE_INTERPRETER_CLONE3_WRAPPED:-}" ]; then
		_ci_script=${BASH_SOURCE[0]}
		if command -v readlink >/dev/null 2>&1 && _rp=$(readlink -f "${_ci_script}" 2>/dev/null); then
			_ci_script=${_rp}
		fi
		if [ -x /usr/local/bin/clone3-workaround ]; then
			export _CODE_INTERPRETER_CLONE3_WRAPPED=1
			exec /usr/local/bin/clone3-workaround /bin/bash "${_ci_script}" "$@"
		else
			echo "code-interpreter: EXECD_CLONE3_COMPAT is set but /usr/local/bin/clone3-workaround is missing (not installed for this architecture); continuing without wrapper" >&2
		fi
	fi
	unset _ci_script _rp
	;;
*)
	echo "code-interpreter: invalid EXECD_CLONE3_COMPAT=${EXECD_CLONE3_COMPAT:-} (use 1, true, yes, on, or reexec)" >&2
	exit 1
	;;
esac

	unset EXECD_CLONE3_COMPAT
fi

record_env_selection() {
	local lang=$1
	local version=$2

	if [ -z "$version" ]; then
		return
	fi

	local tmp_file
	tmp_file=$(mktemp)

	if [ -f "$BASHRC_FILE" ]; then
		grep -vE "^source /opt/code-interpreter/code-interpreter-env.sh ${lang}(\\s|$)" "$BASHRC_FILE" >"$tmp_file" || true
	else
		: >"$tmp_file"
	fi

	echo "source /opt/code-interpreter/code-interpreter-env.sh ${lang} ${version}" >>"$tmp_file"
	mv "$tmp_file" "$BASHRC_FILE"
}

# This script is used to switch versions of different languages in the OpenSandbox environment
# Usage: source /opt/code-interpreter/code-interpreter-env.sh <language> <version>
# Examples:
#   source /opt/code-interpreter/code-interpreter-env.sh python 3.13
#   source /opt/code-interpreter/code-interpreter-env.sh java 21
#   source /opt/code-interpreter/code-interpreter-env.sh node 22
#   source /opt/code-interpreter/code-interpreter-env.sh go 1.25

function usage() {
	echo "Usage: source code-interpreter-env.sh <language> <version>"
	echo "Supported languages: python, java, node, go"
}

DEFAULT_PY_VERSION=${DEFAULT_PY_VERSION:-3.13}
DEFAULT_JAVA_VERSION=${DEFAULT_JAVA_VERSION:-21}
DEFAULT_NODE_VERSION=${DEFAULT_NODE_VERSION:-22}
DEFAULT_GO_VERSION=${DEFAULT_GO_VERSION:-1.25}

append_env_if_needed() {
	local key=$1
	local value=$2
	if [ -z "${EXECD_ENVS:-}" ]; then
		return
	fi
	# Best-effort: ensure parent dir exists, ignore errors.
	mkdir -p "$(dirname "$EXECD_ENVS")" 2>/dev/null || true
	printf '%s=%s\n' "$key" "$value" >>"$EXECD_ENVS" 2>/dev/null || true
}

function switch_python() {
	local version=$1
	if [ -z "$version" ]; then
		echo "Available Python versions:"
		find /opt/python/versions -maxdepth 1 -name "cpython-*" -type d -printf "%f\n" | cut -d'-' -f2 | sort -V
		return
	fi

	# Find matching version directory
	local target_dir=$(find /opt/python/versions -maxdepth 1 -type d -name "cpython-${version}*" | sort -V | tail -n 1)

	if [ -d "$target_dir" ]; then
		export PATH="$target_dir/bin:$PATH"
		append_env_if_needed PATH "$PATH"
		echo "Switched to Python $(python3 --version)"
	else
		echo "Python version $version not found."
	fi
}

function switch_java() {
	local version=$1
	if [ -z "$version" ]; then
		echo "Available Java versions:"
		ls /usr/lib/jvm/ | grep -E '^java-[0-9]+-openjdk' | cut -d'-' -f2 | sort -V | uniq
		return
	fi

	# Match openjdk path
	local java_home=""
	if [ -d "/usr/lib/jvm/java-${version}-openjdk-amd64" ]; then
		java_home="/usr/lib/jvm/java-${version}-openjdk-amd64"
	elif [ -d "/usr/lib/jvm/java-${version}-openjdk-arm64" ]; then # ARM compatibility
		java_home="/usr/lib/jvm/java-${version}-openjdk-arm64"
	fi

	if [ -n "$java_home" ]; then
		export JAVA_HOME="$java_home"
		export PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH"
		append_env_if_needed JAVA_HOME "$JAVA_HOME"
		append_env_if_needed PATH "$PATH"
		echo "Switched to Java $version ($JAVA_HOME)"
	else
		echo "Java version $version not found."
	fi
}

function switch_node() {
	local version=$1
	if [ -z "$version" ]; then
		echo "Available Node versions:"
		ls /opt/node/
		return
	fi

	# Find matching version (e.g. v18 -> v18.x.x)
	local target_dir=$(find /opt/node -maxdepth 1 -type d -name "v${version}*" | sort -V | tail -n 1)

	if [ -d "$target_dir" ]; then
		export PATH="$target_dir/bin:$PATH"
		append_env_if_needed PATH "$PATH"
		echo "Switched to Node $(node --version)"
	else
		echo "Node version $version not found."
	fi
}

function switch_go() {
	local version=$1
	if [ -z "$version" ]; then
		echo "Available Go versions:"
		ls /opt/go/
		return
	fi

	# Find matching version
	local target_dir=$(find /opt/go -maxdepth 1 -type d -name "${version}*" | sort -V | tail -n 1)

	if [ -d "$target_dir" ]; then
		export GOROOT="$target_dir"
		export PATH="$GOROOT/bin:$PATH"
		append_env_if_needed GOROOT "$GOROOT"
		append_env_if_needed PATH "$PATH"
		echo "Switched to Go $(go version)"
	else
		echo "Go version $version not found."
	fi
}

# Main logic
LANG=$1
VER=$2

if [ -z "$LANG" ]; then
	usage
	return
fi

case $LANG in
python)
	if [ -z "$VER" ]; then
		VER=$DEFAULT_PY_VERSION
	fi
	switch_python $VER
	;;
java)
	if [ -z "$VER" ]; then
		VER=$DEFAULT_JAVA_VERSION
	fi
	switch_java $VER
	;;
node)
	if [ -z "$VER" ]; then
		VER=$DEFAULT_NODE_VERSION
	fi
	switch_node $VER
	;;
go)
	if [ -z "$VER" ]; then
		VER=$DEFAULT_GO_VERSION
	fi
	switch_go $VER
	;;
*)
	echo "Unsupported language: $LANG"
	usage
	;;
esac

default_branch="${RELEASE_DEFAULT_BRANCH:-main}"
release_ref="${RELEASE_REF:-${GITHUB_SHA:-HEAD}}"
remote_ref="refs/remotes/${remote}/${default_branch}"

git fetch --force --no-tags "$remote" \
  "+refs/heads/${default_branch}:${remote_ref}"

release_commit="$(git rev-parse --verify "${release_ref}^{commit}")"
default_branch_commit="$(git rev-parse --verify "${remote_ref}^{commit}")"

  echo "::error::Release commit ${release_commit} is not reachable from ${remote}/${default_branch}."
  exit 1
fi

  {
    echo "## Release source verified"
    echo
    echo "Commit \`${release_commit}\` is reachable from \`${remote}/${default_branch}\`."
  } >>"$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
fi
